content: Dockerfile guidance favors explicit, maintainable Dockerfiles: multi-stage builds, minimal runtime images, non-root users, clear EXPOSE/port behavior, and no hidden side effects. A Dockerfile-first scaffolder should treat an existing Dockerfile as application-owned, inspect it read-only, warn about risky omissions, and only generate a Dockerfile when the operator explicitly accepts a template. Generated Dockerfiles should be committed to the app repo for review and future ownership.
